_note: Binding read rows + install/patch write effects. Source: app/views/scheduler/views.py:163-291. Representative goldens in D-30 style; ordering/install-shape verified against contract test_list_ordered_newest_first/test_install_shape.

install_write.after_response: 201 with next_run_at SET (computed first fire, e.g. hourly dtstart 1h ago -> next top of hour), actor = installing user id, last_run/last_run_status/last_run_ended_at null, last_error '', pod/pod_name null unless a pod id was sent
install_write.before: POST {scheduler, project, dtstart, tzid, rrule} (project must be present in body - F36-03 required quirk)
install_write.stored: R5 row + R6 next_run_at when the computed fire is non-null (stored NULL differs, so the :218 condition holds)
install_write.unique_violation: second identical install -> 400 {'non_field_errors': ['The fields scheduler, project must make a unique set.']} WITHOUT touching the DB for the write

next_run_at_rules.create_writes_when: computed is not None AND binding.next_run_at != computed (views.py:218) - stored value is NULL at that point
next_run_at_rules.patch_refresh: binding.refresh_from_db() before computing (:270), so the computation sees the just-saved row
next_run_at_rules.patch_recompute_when: any trigger key present in request.data (:266-268) - presence, not value change: PATCH {enabled: false} never recomputes, PATCH {rrule: <same>} does
next_run_at_rules.patch_writes_when: computed is not None, NO comparison with stored (:272)

patch_write.after: 200 re-render of the in-memory row (post-save values; next_run_at updated in memory when recomputed)
patch_write.before: PATCH {rrule: 'FREQ=DAILY'} on an hourly binding with next_run_at T1
patch_write.stored: R7 full UPDATE then R6 UPDATE (next_run_at T2 != T1 in general)

quirks: body-project/URL-project mismatch: the unique check validates the BODY project but save() pins the URL project (views.py:207-212) - a body project that passes the check with a duplicate URL project IntegrityErrors at save -> 400 {'error': 'The payload is not valid'} (derived edge, unpinned by tests)
detail GET/PATCH/uninstall serialize WITHOUT select_related (R2) while list pre-joins (R1) - same JSON, different query counts

install with a scheduler id that is disabled, foreign-workspace, soft-deleted, or absent from the body 404s {'detail': 'No Scheduler matches the given query.'} (guard precedes validation; pk=None matches no row). A MALFORMED (non-UUID) scheduler id instead 400s {'error': 'Please provide valid detail'}: UUIDField.get_prep_value raises Django ValidationError (not DoesNotExist), mapped by BaseAPIView.handle_exception - same mechanism as pod='bogus' in F36-03

rows.note: newest first (R1 ORDER BY -created_at); runner wire fields populated
last_run join LEFT: status/ended_at surface when a run exists

rows_excluded.note: same scheduler installed on another project is a different row
detail GET with another project's binding id 404s (tenant isolation)
